maddeler.e:
أتعارض (form VI)
# أَتَعَارَضُ (ʔataʕāraḍu) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.ra.dˤu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَعَارَضَ (taʕāraḍa)
# أَتَعَارَضَ (ʔataʕāraḍa) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.ra.dˤa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَعَارَضَ (taʕāraḍa)
# أَتَعَارَضْ (ʔataʕāraḍ) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.radˤ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَعَارَضَ (taʕāraḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
